plan.title: Clear absent on saved eRFX draft

steps.note: Open the Events list to reach the saved draft.
Enable eRFX projects so the draft is an eRFX project.
Set the company configuration under test, which should remove Clear from event creation.
Apply the additional configuration specified for this draft scenario.
Confirm the events list rendered successfully.
Switch to the Drafts tab as required by the case.
Open the top saved draft from the Drafts list.
Assert that the Clear control is not offered on the saved eRFX draft.
